gh_hugepage_reserve.comment: the reserve exists because Gunyah could not take guest memory without migrating it out of CMA; Qualcomm fixed that in 6.18, where the module is no longer needed

udmabuf.comment: generic dma-buf provider/repair, nothing Gunyah about it: any SoC

nproc_guard.comment: no-reboot rescue for the per-uid RLIMIT_NPROC ucounts desync that wedges the app; loaded by the daemon with uid=<app uid>. Any SoC.
